scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "bun run dev:client" "bun run dev:server"
scripts.lint: eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ --cache-strategy content client/src/ server/ tests/ e2e/
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ --cache-strategy content --fix client/src/ server/ tests/ e2e/
scripts.validate: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run knip && bun run build
scripts.test:e2e: DATABASE_PATH=test.db bun e2e/seed.ts && DATABASE_PATH=test.db bun test --timeout 30000 e2e/
scripts.test:all: bun test tests/ && DATABASE_PATH=test.db bun e2e/seed.ts && DATABASE_PATH=test.db bun test --timeout 30000 e2e/
